name: latent
description: Latent (latentpowered.com) reels. Source: Downloads\brand (BRAND.md, web/latent-brand.css, reel-type.png).
rules: Dark only: #000 ground. No white boards, pill badges, chips or fake buttons.
Captions: Bricolage Grotesque 800 caps 84px, one Instrument Serif italic accent word, one orange #fa4c14 word. Pop in, no fade-out, no text stroke.
All on-screen text sits in the single caption spot mid-chest (y ~1240, ~1380 when the speaker is framed low). Never on the face.
Graphics go at the TOP of the frame below the 250px app bar; push the camera down/in (scale ~1.18, y +140) so the face stays clear.
Center-align everything. No blur on text or cards. No cards left tilted in 3D.
Few full-screen graphic slides; prefer animated graphics over the footage.
The pinecone appears only in the outro. Music runs through the outro and its 2s hold with a ~2s fade-out.
Voice must be loud: about -11.5 LUFS voice, final reel around -13 LUFS.
